_README: Copy to bridge.config.json. NON-SECRET settings only - secrets stay in .env
(see .env.example). Every field is optional; the defaults below are what you
get if you delete it. Environment variables override anything set here.
Keys starting with _ are documentation and are ignored by the loader.
Apply changes with `npm run reload`, which validates BEFORE stopping anything.
_repoDir: The repo the agent actually works in. Point this at a scratch clone, not at
the bridge's own directory. Default: the bridge directory, which is rarely
what you want. ~ is expanded. The startup banner refuses to stay quiet if
the path is missing, is not a git repo, or has no git identity configured -
that last one otherwise surfaces as a failed commit minutes into a turn.
_model: Pinned on purpose. Leaving it unset takes the runtime default, which drifts
as new models ship. Env: COPILOT_MODEL
_effort: One of low, medium, high, xhigh. (listModels() also reports 'max', though
the published types omit it and it is unverified here.) Also pinned: the
runtime default resolved to 'medium', so the agent was quietly thinking less
hard than it could. Env: COPILOT_EFFORT
_yolo: Auto-approve every tool call. There is no human-in-the-loop approval path
over Teams, so setting this false does not prompt you - it denies tools and
the agent can only talk. True is what makes 'code from Teams' actually code.
It also means anyone who gets past the allowlist runs commands on this box.
_voiceFile: Appended to the system prompt so replies suit someone reading on a phone at
a traffic light rather than a terminal. Measured effect: 1460 chars over 64
lines with a code fence, down to 694 chars over 5 lines with none.
A missing file is a loud warning in the banner, not a silent revert.
_allowedAadIds: THE ONLY REAL AUTHORISATION CONTROL. HMAC proves a message came from Teams;
it says nothing about who sent it. An empty list means ANYONE in the channel
can run code here. To fill it: send one message and read the sender's
aadObjectId out of the bridge log. Compared case-insensitively, fail-closed.
